name: Helm of Darkness
body:
Price 125,000 gp; Slot head; CL 13th; Weight 3 lbs.; Aura strong varied

DESCRIPTION

The helm of darkness is similar to a helm of brilliance, except it has 10 black diamonds that can be used for umbral strike, 20 jets that can be used for greater invisibility, 30 onyxes that can be used for gloomblind bolts, and 40 black opals that can be used for deeper darkness. In addition, the wearer gains resistance to cold 30 and his weapons become ghost touch weapons instead of flaming weapons. Other aspects of the helm, such as detecting and damaging undead, remain unchanged.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 62,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells deeper darkness, detect undead, ghost whip, gloomblind bolts, greater invisibility, umbral strike, protection from energy
